locator: Fig. 6A lower chloride points and Fig. 6C voltage points at the same external K, Fig. 5 and Table I
preparation: DIDS-treated human red cells, pH 7.5. Five donor series pooled three valinomycin and two gramicidin experiments.
mapping: Negative electrical current denotes outward chloride transfer. Internal chloride is inferred from the Donnan ratio. Voltage estimates come from a parallel pH assay. Chloride current is inferred from shrinkage under the assumption of equal net K and Cl efflux. Read the symbols for voltage, independently of the fitted curve. The plotted SD describes the five series. Donor-level covariance is unavailable.
